blocks.text: Following the announcement of his new album ‘Dream Fatigue’ arriving on November 6th, multi-platinum artist Rex Orange County shares the third offering from the forthcoming project, “Hannah Montana”. Fans can stream the new single HERE and pre-save the album HERE. Photo Credit: George Muncey “Hannah Montana” sees the singer-songwriter and multi-instrumentalist collaborating with Swedish composer and producer Simon Hessman (Yung Lean, 21 Savage). Alongside the new single is a music video directed by Rhys Scarabosio, which captures Rex finding peace in the wild of Montana amongst horses.
